build_quaternion_to_rotation_matrix: build a python module to convert quaternions to 3x3 rotation matrices using quaternion_to_rotation_matrix
build_wigner_d_l2_einsum: build a python module to compute l=2 Wigner D matrices from quaternions using einsum tensor contraction
build_wigner_d_matmul_l3_l4: build a python module to compute l=3 or l=4 Wigner D matrices from quaternions using matmul
build_wigner_d_l3l4_batched: build a python module to compute l=3 and l=4 Wigner D matrices in a single batched matmul
build_custom_kernel_module: build a pytorch nn.Module that loads and holds precomputed Wigner D coefficient tensors as buffers
